work_experience.description: I’m leading full‑stack delivery of HR self‑service features, from domain modelling to .NET services, a React/TypeScript UI, and integrations with SAP and the enterprise data hub. I built and maintain the Employee Dashboard, with an accessibility‑first component library and CI coverage with Jest. I also designed a knowledge‑ingestion pipeline for an internal OpenAI‑based chatbot using conversational retrieval, improving findability and time‑to‑answer with strong auditability and privacy controls. Alongside delivery, I help define the target architecture and technical strategy for HR IT, including build‑vs‑buy decisions and cross‑system integration blueprints.

I delivered enhancements to a high‑traffic web platform, improving the user experience and Core Web Vitals through focused front‑end optimisation. I kicked off a university‑facing portal by defining the architecture, domain model, tech choices, and documentation to support a clean handover and fast iteration. I integrated Sanity CMS to enable content‑driven features with reliable publishing to the front end, and supported experimentation through GrowthBook setup and analysis. I also mentored the team via structured code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing across Next.js/TypeScript and .NET.

I significantly enhanced the company’s software offerings. I designed and developed a comprehensive UI components library for Angular applications, empowering users to extend and tailor it for proprietary solutions. I planned and implemented new features, improving the user experience across various products. Extensive refactoring and optimization of legacy code enhanced system performance and maintainability. I created detailed technical documentation, facilitating smoother onboarding and better product utilization. Mentoring junior developers accelerated their growth and bolstered team effectiveness.
